html:
A folk metal band from Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia, formed in 2016. They mix heavy rock with old Mongolian instruments: the morin khuur horsehead fiddle, the tovshuur lute and throat singing.

They call their style hunnu rock, after the Xiongnu, the steppe empire known in Mongolian as Hünnü. Some lyrics use old war cries and poems in Mongolian. Their videos, shot on horseback across open grassland, spread fast online in 2018 and won them fans and tours far beyond Asia.

The band belongs to a wider return to steppe culture after the end of communist rule in 1990, when the memory of Genghis Khan and the Mongol Empire came back into public life. Earlier, the Tuvan group Huun-Huur-Tu had brought throat singing to world music stages.
